name: Nepal
description: Nepal from the birth of the Buddha and the valley kingdoms to unification, Rana rule, Everest, civil war and the republic.

checkpoints.name: The valley kingdoms
checkpoints.note: The Buddha was born at Lumbini in the south. The Licchavis and then the Mallas ruled the Kathmandu Valley and filled its cities with temples, while the hill kingdom of Gorkha grew to the west.

checkpoints.name: Unification
checkpoints.note: Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha conquered the valley in 1768 and made one kingdom. It pushed its borders far until war with the East India Company ended in the Treaty of Sugauli.

checkpoints.name: The Ranas
checkpoints.note: Jung Bahadur Rana seized power in 1846, and his family ruled as hereditary prime ministers for a century while the kings reigned only in name.

checkpoints.name: Kings and democracy
checkpoints.note: The revolution of 1951 brought King Tribhuvan back and opened the country. Hillary and Tenzing climbed Everest in 1953, B. P. Koirala was elected in 1959, and the king later ruled alone until 1990.

checkpoints.name: War and the republic
checkpoints.note: A Maoist insurgency became ten years of civil war, and most of the royal family was killed in 2001. The monarchy ended in 2008, Prachanda led the first republican government, the 2015 earthquake shook the country, and youth protests toppled the government in 2025.
